in_marathi.name: Divyashan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyashan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyashan is a Sanskrit name for a divine or celestial lord. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'divya' meaning divine and 'ishan' meaning lord. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture who are believed to have divine qualities or are destined for greatness.
